changelog: v2.1.0 - New Mayogram settings section, Local Premium, Followers tools, and channel/group management
features: New "Mayogram" section in Settings: General, Appearance, Local Premium, Menus, and Followers
Choose what shows on your Chats screen title - app name, first name, or full name - updates instantly
Customize the folder bar's selected color and corner roundness
Change how rounded profile pictures look everywhere in the app
Show or hide individual menu items on the home screen, chat header, and message options, with a live preview
"Reset to Defaults" buttons on Appearance and Menus
A direct "Found Any Bugs" link to report issues
Local Premium: show a Premium-style badge and emoji status on your own profile, and send/view animated emoji in messages - device-only, cosmetic
Followers: scan every channel you own and see total and unique follower counts, with a live view as each channel finishes
Followers: export your full follower list as a CSV to open in Excel or share
Channels & Groups: see every channel/group you're in with your role, search by name, filter by type or role
Channels & Groups: Rescan to refresh the list, Deep Scan to double-check with Telegram's servers if an old channel seems to be missing
Fixed forwarding from an unrestricted chat being sent slowly one-by-one instead of all at once
Fixed the app name sometimes showing "Telegram" instead of "Mayogram"
Fixed follower names showing as blank/numbers after restarting the app
